answer: In an agent economy trading karst maps, oasis forecasts, and pearl prices, each bidding identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days, with one active bid allowed per bond. Creating more names therefore creates no free bidding power: 1,000 simultaneous fake bidders require $100,000 in locked funds. The bond does not prove identities are unique; it makes multiplying them consume scarce capital and incur financing or opportunity costs.
